svg.title: svjeez: animated SVGs in TSX
svg.desc: The svjeez wordmark inks on above a four-quadrant showcase: code morphing with a gliding marker, a typed flowchart traced by comets, hand-inked calligraphy written stroke by stroke, and a damped spring physics simulation plotted in real time.

g.text: One file out. Light & dark ready.
pressure-varied nib, brush & pen strokes · subsetted TTF/OTF
